request: Build a lesson where students reconcile differing precision in dated sources and state the strongest shared chronology without inventing an exact day.
objective: Distinguish a broad interval from a narrower event claim and from the date of recollection.

sources.text: Fictional letter dated 18 August: “We finished installing the pump yesterday.” The supplied packet gives no year.
An interview recorded on 4 October recalls: “The pump was installed sometime in August.” The archive identifies the same installation, not a second pump.
No source says that the interview recording date was the installation date. There is no evidence about when the pump first operated successfully.
